counting_rule: Sum nonnegative primary after-before exactly once per life/request ID. Related clones count actual separate Native executions, never inherited ages, aliases, wall CPU seconds, deterministic record recalculations or inherited idle_ticks.

material_requests.boundary_source: preserved failure after_tick plus preceding own-run primary/startup boundary

limits: Snapshot of completed ledger prefix, not an instantaneous observation of a live owner
An unclosed run may already have advanced before its final material receipt is logged; do not certify an exact remaining budget while it runs
Any subsequent Native development/panel/continuation must be added before the reserved batch; rerun this passive tally only, not the experiments
